bio.title: About
bio.text: I'm Jack, a web engineer with 13+ years of experience building human-focused digital experiences. My specialisms include design systems, accessible UI, leadership and system integrations within cross-functional teams. Originally coming from a background in music production, I'm a huge film and music nerd but I also like games, writing, travel, reading and making music. Based in Manchester.
